title: Social Media Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request your data from Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other social media platforms. Protect your privacy with this ready-to-use letter.
description: Exercise your privacy rights with this comprehensive letter template. Request data access, deletion, or portability from major social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and X (Twitter). Includes step-by-step guidance for each platform.

sections.heading: Letter Header
sections.content:
[Your Full Name]
[Your Address]
[City, State, ZIP Code]
[Your Email Address]
[Your Phone Number]

Date: [Current Date]

[Platform Privacy Team]
[Platform Company Name]
[Platform Address]

Subject: Privacy Rights Request - [Request Type]

sections.heading: Account Identification
sections.content:
Dear Privacy Team,

I am writing to exercise my privacy rights regarding my account on your platform. Please find my account details below:

Account Information:
- Username/Handle: [Your Username]
- Email associated with account: [Account Email]
- Account creation date (approximate): [Creation Date]
- Phone number (if applicable): [Phone Number]

sections.heading: Privacy Rights Request
sections.content:
I am exercising my rights under applicable privacy laws including GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant regulations. I hereby request:

☐ Access to my personal data (Right to Know)
☐ Deletion of my personal data (Right to Delete)
☐ Data portability (Right to Data Portability)
☐ Correction of inaccurate personal data
☐ Opt-out of sale/sharing of personal data
☐ Information about data sharing with third parties

Specifically, I request information about:
- All personal data you have collected about me
- Sources of this personal data
- Business purposes for collecting this data
- Categories of third parties with whom you share my data
- Data retention periods
- Advertising data and targeting profiles

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
For identity verification purposes, I have attached/included:

☐ Government-issued photo ID
☐ Screenshot of my account profile
☐ Recent account activity confirmation
☐ Answer to security question: [Security Answer]

I understand you may need additional verification, and I am prepared to provide reasonable proof of identity while protecting my privacy.

sections.heading: Response Requirements
sections.content:
Please provide your response within the legally required timeframe (typically 30-45 days). I request that you:

1. Confirm receipt of this request within 10 business days
2. Provide data in a commonly used, machine-readable format
3. Include clear explanations of any technical terms or codes
4. Notify me if you cannot fulfill this request and explain why

Preferred delivery method:
☐ Secure email to: [Preferred Email]
☐ Secure download link
☐ Physical mail to address above

If you need to contact me, please use: [Preferred Contact Method]

sections.heading: Legal Notice and Closing
sections.content:
Please note that this request is made under my legal rights as a data subject. I expect full compliance with applicable privacy laws. If you cannot fulfill this request, please provide specific legal grounds for denial.

I reserve the right to file a complaint with the relevant supervisory authority if my request is not handled appropriately or within the required timeframe.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to your response.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]

Enclosures: Identity verification documents (as applicable)
